architecture: one-layer 24-unit tanh RNN; context = instantaneous features + centred ±0.48s mean + centred ±2s mean + contrast of ±0.48s means at ±1s (120 features); offline tracking only
training: from scratch, unweighted known-frame CE, dropout0.15, L2 0.0001, Adam, clip norm5, 16 sampled iterations, 1024 windows/iteration, 128-frame windows, 16-window batch, seed42
selection: highest mean clean/dropout validation spell F1 among new candidates passing false-positive <=110% reference and short pulses <=reference+5. If none eligible, freeze best new F1 candidate as rejected experimental diagnostic; never substitute reference silently. Ties prefer earlier iteration and smaller penalty.
test_policy: checksum only before candidate, baseline and comparator freeze; score once; no post-test tuning
unknown_policy: unknown X retained, excluded loss, never invented dead labels
limitations: Automatic partial H/A labels are not independent full-match ground truth.
Heldout teams have appeared in an earlier viewed test but not in this training pool.
Context is offline, uses future tracking, and can span unknown-label gaps without filling their labels.
test_ablations: Evaluate both validation-selected frozen families and comparators; never choose using test scores
training_augmentation: home/away swap × clean/fixed contiguous ball dropout; four sequences per half
